lessons.situation: Repeating an earlier implication after a material release or guidance stage.
lessons.rule: Check what actually arrived and any decisive follow-up before repeating the implication. Missing guidance remains a named gap. Changing a check/save clock cannot renew old evidence.
lessons.exceptions: No automatic checkpoint selection or deadline renewal is required for a news refresh.

lessons.situation: A familiar directional story is retained despite stronger contrary evidence.
lessons.rule: Compare the strongest contrary mechanism on the same horizon and evidence standard. Let it change the implication when it removes support, rather than burying it in a caveat.
lessons.exceptions: Mixed or no clear fresh signal is valid; old Strong/Moderate/Slight procedures are retired.

lessons.situation: An older domestic policy foundation is combined with temporary haven, risk or funding conditions.
lessons.rule: Keep domestic policy background separate from changing session conditions. Weigh already-published contrary developments, including credible negotiations, before carrying forward the previous sign.
lessons.exceptions: Do not demand realised flows or a completed agreement as the only evidence of a potential change. This does not prove a cross-currency trade.

lessons.situation: Historical results are used to justify a news interpretation.
lessons.rule: A favourable extreme does not establish a correct closing verdict, causal explanation or executable profit. Keep pre-delivery moves, later news and the original information set separate.
lessons.exceptions: Historical attribution context only; routine news refreshes do not capture or score outcomes.

lessons.situation: Opposing facts are mentioned but tested more strictly than the preferred story.
lessons.rule: Apply the same standard to both mechanisms. Do not demand a completed agreement for one side while crediting expectations for the other. A US-Canada spread is not an observed EUR-Canada spread. Change an unsupported conclusion rather than decorating it with caveats.
lessons.exceptions: This is a process lesson, not proof of a profitable opposite trade.

note: Condensed process context for Currency News. Exact original wording and reviewed evidence remain in the preservation archive. No forecasting, checkpoint or outcome-measurement procedure is implied.
